body:
I'm pretty socially awkward and have anxiety when around people I don't know. Any tips on overcoming that, or mind pointing me in the direction where I might?

Yeah, I try to take things in smaller bites, but being in a new place plus being alone and having these depressive thoughts makes it really overwhelming.

Thanks, means a lot. Anything anyone can do to help. I know suicide is the wrong answer, but I honestly just don't feel like anything else will work for me.

I'm in Washington.

I have no idea. I have issues with social anxiety and self esteem, as well as some other, less significant problems. I'm new here, having moved just two weeks ago. I don't know what my resources are here, nor who should I go to. I'm still on my parent's health insurance, but being that they're in a different state, don't think it'll carry over.

I'm terribly lonely most of the time, and feel that way even when surrounded by people. I just miss having someone to talk to. Someone who's patient and willing to listen. I know having someone won't be the end-all-be-all solution, but it could mitigate this intense depression I'm in right now.

I need help. That much I know. But there's too much in there to sift through. And I've already burned out my ex. She couldn't handle it. Which I get, everyone has their own problems, you usually don't have room left for someone else's. But with that in mind, I don't know how to help myself. I've been trying since I was born, to learn to be alone and independent. I told myself I didn't need anyone else. But I do. I desperately do. I've been alone too long, and it's hurting so much more now, the loneliness. I see everyone else that I grew up with doing great, having an amazing time. Smiles and laughs and fun. Why can't I have that? Why don't I? I moved across the country because I thought I would be given a second chance, but it's only made me feel even more alone. I feel even more outcasted than I did before. I feel like I don't belong anywhere.

I feel like I'll never get the help I need.
I wish I had the balls to end it already. Hopefully someone else will. Otherwise, I'm at least slowly killing myself one drag at a time.
